mapper.select: SELECT h.notification_id, h.user_id, st.grade as userGrade, st.name AS userName, st.clazz AS userPost, h.type, st.phone AS phone, h.level, st.sex, h.reading_value, h.recommended_action, h.time FROM health_warning_notifications h LEFT JOIN student st ON h.user_id = st.student_id where h.user_id = st.student_id

SELECT h.notification_id, h.user_id, t.post as userPost, t.name AS userName, h.type, t.sex, t.phone AS phone, h.level, h.reading_key, h.reading_value, h.recommended_action, h.time
FROM health_warning_notifications h LEFT JOIN teacher t ON h.user_id = t.teacher_id where h.user_id = t.teacher_id

SELECT h.notification_id, l.sex, l.post as userPost, h.user_id, l.name AS userName, l.type AS userType, l.phone AS phone, h.level, h.reading_key, h.reading_value, h.recommended_action, h.time FROM health_warning_notifications h LEFT JOIN logistics l ON h.user_id = l.logistics_id where h.user_id = l.logistics_id

SELECT count(*) FROM health_warning_notifications h LEFT JOIN student l ON h.user_id = l.student_id

and h.level like concat('%',#{type},'%')
